overview.name: Panchthar Multiple Campus
overview.university: Tribhuvan University; Nepal Sanskrit University (one-year B.Ed.)
overview.address: Gadhi, Phidim, Panchthar, Koshi Province, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus in Phidim, also listed as Panchthar Campus. Founded in 2039 BS (1982 AD); the Nepal Public Campus Association records the establishment date as 2039-03-17. It is a Tribhuvan University-affiliated community institution offering bachelor's programs in management, humanities, and education, and a master's program in education. EduSanjal and a Nepal Sanskrit University examination-centre notice report a one-year B.Ed. at this campus under Nepal Sanskrit University. It also runs National Examination Board +2 programs in management, education, and humanities. QAA status on the Nepal Public Campus Association listing is In Process. No constituent, medical, engineering, or law campus was found in the district, and no separate CTEVT diploma college was confirmed.
overview.mission: Nurturing responsible and valuable citizens for the nation.

courses.name: Master of Education (M.Ed.) in Nepali and Educational Planning and Management (EPM)

updates.summary: A published examination-centre notice lists Panchthar Multiple Campus, Panchthar, as both a one-year B.Ed. campus and the designated Panchthar examination centre.

overview.name: Yasok Campus
overview.address: Kummayak Rural Municipality-1, Yasok, Panchthar, Koshi Province, Nepal
overview.description: Community higher-education campus in Yasok, established in 2064 BS (published as 2007 AD). Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and listed by the Nepal Public Campus Association. Current program listings confirm four-year B.Ed. and BBS. A published motto is Empowering Minds, Building Communities. Local news in 2018 and 2023 said teaching was underway in education, humanities, and management faculties; current university examination lists and campus directories confirm B.Ed. and BBS, not a separately named BA program. Older TU and directory listings recorded the same Yasok location as Siddhadevi Campus or Siddha Devi Campus (2064 BS, Yasok Bazar). That older name is treated here as an alias, not a fifth campus. An older Siddha Devi directory listing published the phone +977-24-520304; it is not repeated as a current campus phone.
overview.mission: Yasok Campus is committed to delivering accessible, affordable, and high-quality education that fosters the intellectual and personal growth of students. We aim to cultivate a generation of critical thinkers, ethical leaders, and responsible citizens who will drive positive change within Nepal and the global community.
overview.vision: To be a leading educational institution in rural Nepal, recognized for excellence in teaching, learning, and community engagement, with a focus on empowering students to achieve their full potential and contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society.

faqs.question: How long is the BBS at Yasok Campus?
faqs.answer: Four academic years under Tribhuvan University's annual system.

faqs.question: What minimum attendance is published for the BBS?
faqs.answer: At least 70 percent class attendance is required to sit the annual exams, according to the published course page. A separate campus profile states a 75 percent minimum attendance rule.

faqs.question: How is the BBS final year assessed?
faqs.answer: Three concentration papers, Business Research Methods (50 marks), and a Final Project (50 marks) with viva.

qa.question: How long is the BBS?
qa.answer: Four academic years under TU's annual system.

qa.question: What is the minimum attendance?
qa.answer: At least 70% class attendance is required to sit the annual exams.

qa.question: How is the final year assessed?
qa.answer: Three concentration papers, Business Research Methods (50 marks), and a Final Project (50 marks) with viva.

qa.question: Which concentration streams are named?
qa.answer: Accounting, Finance, Management, and Marketing; choose one stream in the fourth year.

qa.question: Who conducts the final exams?
qa.answer: The Office of the Controller of Examinations, Tribhuvan University, conducts annual examinations.

overview.name: Rabi Campus
overview.address: Miklajung Rural Municipality-4, Rabi Bazaar, Panchthar, Koshi Province, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2065 BS (2009 AD); the Nepal Public Campus Association records the establishment date as 2065-09-19. It received Tribhuvan University affiliation in 2065 BS and offers four-year B.Ed. and BBS programs. It is recognized in directory listings by the University Grants Commission. QAA status on the Nepal Public Campus Association page is Applied. EduSanjal has reported 39 students in B.Ed. and 28 in BBS. The campus publishes a journal, Rabi Sangyan, Volume 1, Issue 1, November 2024, ISSN 3059-9423.
overview.mission: The aim of Ravi Campus is to enrich the future life of the students by developing their personality and enhancing their personal excellence.
overview.vision: To achieve excellence in higher education and research and increase access to quality services to all classes and groups of the society.

overview.name: Tharpu Campus
overview.description: Community campus established in 2065 BS (2009 AD) in Tharpu, Yangwarak, Panchthar. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University and described as recognized by the University Grants Commission. It offers a four-year full-time B.Ed. QAA status on the Nepal Public Campus Association listing is Not Applied. Admission Nepal has reported 68 students studying at the campus. An older TU affiliated list used the pre-federal address Tharpu 2; current directory address is Yangwarak-4.
